newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold prices rise, volume down.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold prices rise, volume down.

text.p: Prices firmed on Istanbul's gold exchange on Wednesday in line with world prices but volume slid in lack of fresh demand from the domestic market, dealers said.
Gold closed at $380.40 an ounce and 1,127,100 lira per gram, up from Tuesday's $378.50 and 1,119,000 lira.
But volume dived to 310 kilos from Tuesday's 657 kilos on weaker free market demand, dealers said.
Gold traded on Wednesday above $380 an ounce in New York after $379.20 in London, compared to Tuesday's 18-month low of $378.65.

"The trade was very quiet in the free market. Depending on the season and uncertainty over the world market movements, traders chose to wait. Volume may go down further," said one broker. --Istanbul newsroom +90-212-275 08 75
